scope: Ninja School 1-3 reverse engineering integrity, CFR decompilation quirks, and runtime validation gap tracking
disclaimer: All findings in analysis/antigravity/ represent static decompiled source analysis of CFR 0.152 exports. First-pass source reading must strictly be distinguished from verified runtime behavior on actual J2ME emulators or validated PC engine executions. No game completion or 100% runtime fidelity is claimed without running behavior contracts against engine test fixtures.

cfr_decompilation_quirks_and_errors.issue: Obfuscated synthetic local variables in critical loops
locations: paint(Graphics var1_1) at L7555: CFR introduced synthetic local name var1_1 and deeply nested ternaries for UI rendering.
run() at L8144: CFR introduced synthetic variables var3_3, var4_4 during byte array deserialization in save load branches.
cfr_decompilation_quirks_and_errors.impact: Code flow is logically reconstructible but variable naming and stack operations require bytecode verification (javap -c) when fine-tuning frame-exact timing.

cfr_decompilation_quirks_and_errors.issue: Inverse sprite naming convention in assets
locations: as[0][0][2]=31 (highest offset) maps to er (loaded from /cp/ch*.png) -> HEAD
as[0][1][2]=8 (lowest offset) maps to et (loaded from /cp/cl*.png) -> LEGS
as[0][2][2]=14 (middle offset) maps to eg (loaded from /cp/cb*.png) -> BODY
cfr_decompilation_quirks_and_errors.impact: Naive English naming guesses (ch=legs, cb=head) lead to inverted sprites. Corrected in asset-usage.json to match exact loader, matrix offset Y, and render call.

cfr_decompilation_quirks_and_errors.issue: Cutscene timing semantic misunderstanding in preliminary notes
cfr_decompilation_quirks_and_errors.impact: aB[fW][fX] was previously mislabeled as independent step duration in initial notes. Bytecode and source show gc accumulates from 0 on C(n) and clamps at each milestone; aB values are cumulative tick thresholds.

unresolved_runtime_behavior_items.description: gV tracks boss state in Map 4. When gV == 22, cutscene D(0) step 3 triggers dialogue ('Chết đi, con quái vật hung hăng kia !!!') and warps to Map 0 with eH=true. Need to verify exact HP and attack sequence of the Map 4 prologue boss entity in live gameplay.

Vehicles placed on map with coordinates in in[n], io[n]. Player mounts bike when colliding with vehicle coordinates if eP (license flag) is true. Bike speed go and acceleration mechanics require direct testing.
Sound tracks loaded from /s/{n}.mid with loop count 1000. Volume set to 100. Specific music track IDs mapped per map must be matched with MIDI asset files.
In-game activation and purchase routines invoke SMS background threads targeting sms://8722. In modern PC remakes, this entire branch must be bypassed or replaced with in-game currency purchase.
